{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check revenue format
print("First 5 revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for 'loyal' segment
print("Unique customer_segment values:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Status counts:", sales['status'].value_counts())

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
print("QA order count (revenue == 999999.99):", (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
